about: Condi's Shunter sound set v1 for Prod's Freight Bay build (D-20 section 7.4). The horn is the one Skyiah approved; the other seven are candidates, not approved. Same shape as the five-weapon events.json, so RangeAudio.setup("res://audio/sigmaudio/shunter") reads it unchanged. Times are seconds.
level_contract: Files are level-matched to the approved horn (momentary maximum, BS.1770 400 ms): the horn is the loudest thing the Shunter says, the brace scrape (the rush warning) sits 2 LU under it. Play every file at ONE volume_db through the SFX bus and trim the bus, not single players. Suggested start: volume_db 0, then one trim by ear against the guns. Never put any of these on the Music bus.
player_hint: All eight are the Shunter's own sounds: AudioStreamPlayer3D on (or at) the Shunter, so the player hears where it is. Two need a handle so the game can fade them: shunter.rush and shunter.plume_hiss. The others are one-shots. Files start within 3 ms of the event; no pre-roll.

events.note: APPROVED by Skyiah 2026-10-16. Byte-identical copy of approved_music_v1's shunter-horn-tuned.wav (44.1 kHz mono 24-bit, left as it was). Rings 2.5 s, past the 0.6 s pose into CLOSE, by design. Same frame as FreightBayMusic.trigger_event("engage").

The rush warning. Hydraulic drop, the lip touches the deck at +0.20 s (the plough reaches the deck at 0.25 s), then a grind that swells and rises to its loudest at +0.6-0.8 s, where RUSH starts. Let it play out under the rush. A broken brace (heavy hit) can cut it with a 25 ms fade.

Drive motors spool up in 0.3 s, a gallop of paired footfalls every 0.27 s, the lip skimming the deck. When the rush ends (player hit, miss, crate, steel or death), fade it out over 25 ms on that frame and play the matching end sound. If it runs the full 1.1 s it tails off by itself.

events.trigger: the rush ends on a pillar, wall or closed gate (the 1.8 s crumple)
events.note: Plough slams flat on steel, a crunch, the body's rebound at +0.16 s, and the steam burst D-20 lists for the crumple (from +0.12 s). Then shunter.plume_hiss as RECOVER starts.

events.trigger: the rush ends on open floor or bursts an orange crate (1.1 s); also on DOWN if it was rushing
events.note: The nose digs in, then a grind that falls in pitch and closes down as it slews to a stop. It falls where the brace scrape rises, so the warning and the miss never read alike. The crate's own burst sound, if any, plays on top.

events.trigger: a heavy hit (plough rating 14 per the D-20 addendum) jolts it during RECOVER: 'the vents gust'
events.note: Flaps bang, a short forced gust. Short and bright on purpose, unlike the steady plume. Can also be used for the jolt on a heavy hit while it works or closes if Prod wants one sound for every heavy jolt.
Flaps open, then a steady warm hiss. Fade it out over the window's LAST 0.2 s, the same moment the plume fades, so the player hears the window closing. 2.4 s long so the 1.8 s window never runs out.

Relay clunk, the hydraulics sigh, pump and drive spin down over about 2.2 s, and the body settles onto the deck at +2.25 s. Stop shunter.rush and shunter.plume_hiss (25 ms fade) on the same frame. Same frame as FreightBayMusic.trigger_event("victory").

not_in_this_set: Footfalls while closing, the tend/dock/tote sounds and any crate-burst sound are not among the seven D-20 asked for, so none were made.
